svg.title: Malpaco · Late game: objective requested by the player · desktop
svg.desc: Late game: objective requested by the player. Revision 3, original static concept, not implemented or playtested. Portrait turns the same board 90 degrees. Quiet portrait is fitted; phone turn/capture show zoomed focus. Counts and action icons stay upright. Full-viewport original organic geography is schematic, not generation evidence. Text belongs to this interaction and clears when it ends; required choices remain recoverable.
